name: com.mindattic.components.unity
description: The MindAttic design system for Unity 6: themed uGUI + TextMeshPro menus and controls that look like the MindAttic web components (same token names and palette as web/themes, dark by default, light built in). MenuStack/MenuScreen for game menus, Modal alert/confirm/busy, Toast, Tooltip, Button, IconButton, Toggle, Textbox, Select, Range, ProgressBar, Spinner, Toolbar, FormRow, a join-code display with copy, and roster lists. Built from code with a small fluent API or from prefabs, keyboard/gamepad navigable with explicit navigation, laid out on a 1920x1080 reference canvas, reduce-motion aware. Works with the Input System UI module and the old input manager.

samples.description: Every component in both themes: open Gallery.unity and press Play. A theme switch, a reduce-motion switch, a menu stack (main menu, multiplayer, lobby with join code and roster, settings), a pause menu on Esc, modals, toasts and a HUD toolbar, all built from code in GalleryDemo.cs.
